{"metadata":{"description":"Make agents in DeepSeek Harness (DSH) stop drawing conclusions from unverified guesses — and make every conclusion auditable.","id":"gh:1365519118","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-evidence-gate","slug":"AaronandWork/dsh-evidence-gate","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Make agents in DeepSeek Harness (DSH) stop drawing conclusions from unverified guesses — and make ev"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ery conclusion auditable."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-evidence-gate"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Make agents in DeepSeek Harness (DSH) stop drawing conclusions from unverified guesses — and make ev"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ery conclusion auditable."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"An agent that says "I read this file" is **cross-checked against the session's actual tool activity*"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"*. A claim with no matching tool log entry is downgraded from VERIFIED to UNVERIFIED on the spot."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Demo / 演示"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Chip ON → the claim goes through evidence_gate before it may be stated / 开关开启 → 结论先过门再落笔"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Per-session toggle: OFF means the gate does not apply to this conversation / 会话级开关：关闭仅影响本会话"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The verdict card follows the GUI language and switches live / 判定卡片跟随 GUI 语言实时切换"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"/evidence-gate report: the per-session ledger, preserved across restarts / 本会话台账，跨重启保留"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Prompt-only "don't guess" instructions are unenforceable and unauditable. This plugin makes conclusi"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"on discipline **structural**:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. **Policy** — a system-prompt section establishing the evidence hierarchy injected before every mo"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"del step.
2. **Gate** — a model tool the agent calls before stating load-bearing conclusions; each c"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"laim gets a verdict.
3. **Cross-check** — claimed direct observations are verified against the sessi"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"on's recorded tool activity (`tools/result` stream).
4. **Ledger** — per-session counts: how many gu"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"esses were blocked, how many were converted into real verification."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Component | Mechanism |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Policy section | `systemPrompt.section` (order 550), text provider |
| `evidence_gate` tool | regi"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"stered via the `tools` registry; verdicts `VERIFIED / REFERENCED / UNVERIFIED / INVALID / OFF` |
| E"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"vidence hierarchy | `tested / measured / read_directly / prior_verified` (direct) · `documented / co"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"mmunity_practice` (must cite source) · `assumption` (only as a labeled hypothesis + next verificatio"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"n step) |
| Cross-check | `tools/result` listener records a durable per-session evidence index (400 "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"entries) — tool arguments AND output anchors (paths / URLs / distinctive output words); gate claims "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"of direct observation must match it |
| Anti-false-kill ladder | own-session hit → recorded-output k"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"eyword hit → other-session hit (subagent) → existence floor (cited path really exists → pass with ⚠ "},{"id":"p16s9","text":"weak note) → block |
| Metrics | `blocked` (guesses downgraded) vs `converted` (blocked claims that "},{"id":"p16s10","text":"later came back VERIFIED) vs `charity` (existence-floor passes, visible as 采信) |
| Card badges | too"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"l card titles: 🟢 VERIFIED · 🔵 REFERENCED · 🟠 UNVERIFIED · ⚪ OFF |
| Switch | `/evidence-gate on\|off"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"\|status\|report` + `evidence_gate_switch` model tool — **per-session**, persisted |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### v0.2 semantics"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Limitations (read this)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- The policy is a **probabilistic constraint, not a hard guarantee** — nothing in the harness can in"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"tercept final prose. The gate + cross-check + visible ledger is the practical optimum at this layer."},{"id":"p20s3","text":"
- The cross-check only sees what passed through the `tools/result` stream **while the plugin was lo"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"aded**; with an empty index, first-hand claims fall through cross-session lookup and the existence f"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"loor before failing closed.
- Cross-check is corroboration, not truth: a real command run for an unr"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"elated reason can still match, and a determined agent can cite a real path. It raises the cost of ly"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ing, it does not make lying impossible.
- A tool execution that carries **no session identity** fall"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"s into a single shared bucket (the host log warns once when this happens). With multiple main sessio"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"ns, that bucket is shared across them — if you ever see the warning, report which action produced it"},{"id":"p20s10","text":".

| 卡片徽章 | 工具卡标题：🟢"},{"id":"p26s7","text":" 已实证 · 🔵 已引用 · 🟠 已拦截 · ⚪ 门未开启 |
| 开关 | `/evidence-gate on\|off\|status\|report` + `evidence_gate_swi"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"tch` 模型工具——**按会话**，持久保留 |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### 边界（务必阅读）/ Limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- 策略是**概率性约束，不是硬保证**——harness 没有任何机制能拦截最终文本。门 + 交叉核验 + 可见台账已是这一层的实用最优。
- 交叉核验只能看到**插件加载期间**经过 `tools"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"/result` 流的内容；空索引时，第一手声称会先落跨会话查找与存在性底线，然后才失败关闭。
